Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: summon Shardplate
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Call the lesser spren that follow your bond and let them form into Shardplate around you. The armor materializes piece by piece, clicking into place with a sound like settling stone. It is lighter than it looks, and stronger than anything forged by mortal hands.
